population: Forty adults with type 1 diabetes, and twenty adults without diabetes
intervention: metformin 1500 mg versus placebo
main_result: There was no difference in change in endogenous glucose production between metformin and placebo groups

population: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) patients
intervention: Vonoprazan 20 mg vs. Lansoprazole 30 mg
main_result: Both vonoprazan and lansoprazole significantly reduced albumin/creatinine ratio (ACR) from baseline levels after 3 months, but the reduction in albuminuria was significantly greater in the vonoprazan group.

population: adult PwMS from across Sweden
intervention: the 'Fewer Falls in MS' manualized online self-management fall prevention programme
main_result: The evaluation demonstrates that participant recruitment and retention, data collection, intervention delivery, session adherence, and outcome measures were feasible, but no significant between-group differences were found at the 18 weeks follow-up.

population: middle-aged women aged 40-60 years with overweight/obesity
intervention: 12-week 8-hour flexible time-restricted eating (flexTRE) and aerobic exercise (EX), alone or in combination (flexTRE+EX)
main_result: The flexTRE+EX group achieved the greatest fat mass reduction compared to the CON group, with an adjusted mean difference of -2.85 kg

population: infants with <1000 g birth weight
intervention: liberal vs restrictive transfusion strategies
main_result: A liberal transfusion strategy did not reduce intermittent hypoxaemia in infants with <1000 g birth weight

population: women with early-stage breast cancer
intervention: long-term vitamin D supplementation
main_result: No significant changes in testosterone concentrations were observed between treatment groups over the 24 month treatment period.

population: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants (<1500 g and/or gestational age <32 weeks)
intervention: Early enteral bovine lactoferrin (bLf) supplementation
main_result: Early bovine lactoferrin supplementation safely reduces late-onset neonatal sepsis in VLBW infants and may support immunologic, antioxidant, and hematologic stability.

population: patients following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction
intervention: deep oscillation therapy
main_result: Deep oscillation therapy significantly enhanced early rehabilitation outcomes and reduced inflammation in patients after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.

population: women with breast cancer
intervention: Citrus aurantium inhalation aromatherapy vs. sunflower oil
main_result: Citrus aurantium aromatherapy significantly alleviated chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting during the delayed phase (days 3-5)

population: Patients with breast cancer receiving a 125-mg/m 2 paclitaxel chemotherapy regimen
intervention: Gradient pressure therapy
main_result: Gradient pressure therapy effectively reduces symptoms of paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy, improving patients' daily activities

population: healthy adult participants (≥18 years of age; BMI ≥ 18 and ≤30 kg m-2; HbA1C < 42 mmol mol-1, 6.0%)
intervention: white bread made with a starch branching enzyme II (sbeII) mutant wheat flour with elevated amylose vs. isoglucidic white bread made with a wild-type (WT) control flour
main_result: The maximum rise in glucose within 2 hours did not differ significantly between breads (-0.08 ± 0.12 mMol L-1, mean difference ± SE, p = 0.514)

population: women aged 50-74 years in four departments of the Normandy region
intervention: mobile mammography units (MMUs) to increase screening participation
main_result: The MMU intervention was associated with a statistically significant increase in participation of 8.7 % (p < 0.0001) compared with the control arm.

population: postmenopausal women aged 45–65 years with moderate or severe vasomotor symptoms
intervention: a 12-week program combining resistance and aerobic training
main_result: The exercise group showed a large improvement in VMS severity and in somatic symptoms, and significant improvements were also observed in the MENQOL psychosocial and physical domains, MRS psychological symptoms, and PSQI sleep quality.

population: China's working population
intervention: None
main_result: The study found significant cancer risk factors in the working population, with variations across populations and regions highlighting the need for targeted interventions.

population: 38 adults aged 65-75
intervention: CoQ10 supplementation vs. placebo
main_result: The CoQ10 group demonstrated significantly greater improvements in lower-body strength and power, as indicated by the greater gains in 5XSST and 30CST performance compared to the placebo.

population: patients undergoing minimally invasive cardiac surgery (MICS) with cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB)
intervention: continuous furosemide infusion vs no continuous furosemide during CPB
main_result: Continuous furosemide administration during CPB did not effectively reduce the incidence of AKI, but was associated with a significant increase in postoperative urine output and an improvement in the PaO 2 /FiO 2 ratio.

population: women with urgency urinary incontinence (UUI)
intervention: magnetic stimulation (active) vs sham treatment
main_result: The active group demonstrated significantly greater improvement in ICIQ-UI SF scores compared to sham, with a mean change of -4.05 ± 3.23 in the active group.

population: virally suppressed patients with HBsAg level < 3000 IU/mL
intervention: combination treatment of entecavir (ETV) and peginterferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFN) with or without granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF)
main_result: ETV plus Peg-IFN significantly increased HBsAg loss and HBsAg seroconversion, whereas adding GM-CSF conferred no additional efficacy benefit

population: 10 participants
intervention: a high-F dentifrice containing 5000 ppm F
main_result: Bedtime brushing with a 5000-ppm F dentifrice effectively prolongs F retention in the oral environment, especially in the salivary sediment.

population: Participants with obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) enrolled in the STEP-HFpEF and STEP-HFpEF DM trials.
intervention: Semaglutide 2.4 mg once weekly versus placebo
main_result: Treatment with semaglutide improved disease-specific symptoms, physical function, and reduced body weight across the age spectrum in patients with HFpEF.
